Events in the window: (1) QS7001 V1 Common Criteria hardware test report targeted for October 2026 (src 3), already slipped once from September (src 4) - delivery is a modest positive headline, another slip mildly negative; (2) SAIQ began trading Oct 2 (src 6); the PIPE's 60-day price protection runs to ~Nov 30, outside the window, so SAIQ is only a sentiment factor; (3) possible preliminary Q3 metrics release (the company issued prelims on Apr 8 and Jul 8) and possible Quantisimo/GigCapital8 news (src 8). bull.story: PQC certifications and first production orders (QVault TPM, QS7001) plus a renewed quantum-stock rally re-rate the name toward the prior-year $8.71 high; 60.8M Class E warrants at $5.50 and the $28.9M ATM add supply that caps sustained upside.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$1.50 (~$347M market cap) the market would value SEALSQ at or under its projected Oct-2027 net cash alone (~$350M, ~$1.52/share) and below net cash plus haircut stakes (~$1.73/share), i.e. negative value for operations - most likely meaning cash is being transferred out (Quantisimo/related-party SPACs, write-downs of quantum stakes, rising WISeQey receivables), a large dilutive raise, or a failed PQC certification path. I keep $1.50 rather than the supervisor's $1.40 because $1.40 already sits below bare projected cash, which is past the point where something fundamental has broken.

reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor confirmed my cash roll-forward and share count as best supported, and corrected the starting price: the actual 2026-10-02 close was $2.375 (verified in Twelve Data, src 17), ~2% below the brief's $2.425. Primary filings show a ~$549M market cap (2.375 x ~231M economic shares, src 2) that is mostly cash: $486.1M cash+restricted at 30-Jun-2026 (src 1,2), ~$458M by Oct-2026 after the $10M SAIQ PIPE and burn, ~$350M by Oct-2027 after ~$50M burn and ~$55M of further SEALQuantum deployments, i.e. ~$1.52/share net cash (~$1.73 with haircut stakes). Operations are priced at ~$90M EV against a $27-36M FY26 revenue guide at ~48% GM but a $32M H1 operating loss. The cash backing compresses the left tail (P<1.21 ~9%), while burn, deployments into WISeQey-group vehicles (Quantisimo LOI, SAIQ, $16.67M related-party receivables, src 2,6,8), twice-slipped PQC certifications (src 3 vs 4) and PFIC/controlled-company status (src 11) justify a discount, so my blended fair value moves from $2.08 to $2.06, below spot. Right tail: quantum names re-rate violently ($8.71 high within the year) but 60.8M Class E warrants at $5.50 and the ATM add supply, so I keep 5% at >=$6.06 rather than adding to it. Ladder shifted down ~1 point through the middle for the lower starting price; median ~$2.25, P(>=2.42) 44%. 1-month ladder re-centred on ~$2.38 with ~18-20% monthly sigma and a slightly lower left tail. No new web research beyond verifying the close; no option data by design.
